question: En cáncer de pulmón, ¿qué fármacos dirigidos a PDCD1 o CD274 (PD-1 o PD-L1) aparecen en ensayos de fase 3 o fase 2/3?

attempts.query:
WITH farmacos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.pref_name
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.chembl_id = COALESCE(dm.parent_chembl_id, dm.chembl_id)
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol IN ('PDCD1', 'CD274') AND m.pref_name IS NOT NULL
),
ensayos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.nct_id
  FROM aact.studies s
  JOIN aact.browse_conditions bc ON bc.nct_id = s.nct_id
  WHERE bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms'
    AND s.phase IN ('PHASE3', 'PHASE2/PHASE3')
),
nombres AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS nombre FROM aact.interventions i
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o
)
SELECT DISTINCT f.pref_name
FROM farmacos f
JOIN nombres n ON n.nombre LIKE '%' || lower(f.pref_name) || '%'
JOIN ensayos e ON e.nct_id = n.nct_id
ORDER BY 1
